items.title: 68087_Cliff Leeman oral history interview
items.q: Woody had gone and hired Davie Tough who was not quite ready to go to work

ctx.x: Well, you went in the Army and ...

I rehearsed all these things -- I was going to Fort Dix on a Monday, two weeks previous, so I had to give up my job. Woody had gone and hired Davie Tough who was not quite ready to go to work, he had just gotten out of the Navy, he was down in the South Pacific, and was in bad condition -- but he hired Dave to follow me, he hired Dave, and I gave up my apartment in New York, and my first wife had gone to Boston with my son, who had just been born then. He was a young baby. I had no apartment, I had no job, and I…
So you didn't have to go.
